text: もうすぐ終点でしょ?サクサク行っちゃおうよ! / 今話したいの!
translation: We're almost at the end, right? Let's just get moving! / I want to talk now!

vocabulary.meaning: to go ahead and do (contracted form of てしまう)

grammar: 行っちゃおう is 行く + ちゃう (てしまう) in volitional form — 'let's just go ahead and go.' The yo at the end adds a pushing, urging tone.

text: あそこで聞こう!
translation: Let's talk over there!

vocabulary.meaning: to listen, to hear, to ask

grammar: 聞こう is the volitional form of 聞く — 'let's listen/talk.' Context makes clear Tidus means 'let's hear each other out' (i.e., let's go somewhere to talk).

text: 嫌な予感だけは、当たるんだよな
translation: Bad premonitions are always the ones that come true, aren't they.

vocabulary.meaning: to be right, to come true, to hit the mark

grammar: 〜だけは singles out 'only bad premonitions' for the predicate — 'it's specifically bad premonitions that come true.' 〜んだよな seeks commiseration.

text: 私、結婚する
translation: I'm getting married.
grammar: Blunt present-tense statement used as an announcement of a decision — no hedging or politeness markers, which makes it land with dramatic weight.

text: やっぱり / そう来たっすか
translation: Just as I thought. / So it's come to that, huh.

vocabulary.meaning: just as I thought, as expected, after all
to turn out that way, to come to that (set phrase)

grammar: そう来たっすか literally 'so it came that way?' — a colloquial expression of mild surprise that something turned out as anticipated. っす is informal-masculine です.

text: な、どうしてだ? / 気が変わったのか?
translation: Hey, why? / Did you change your mind?
grammar: な at the start is an attention-getter ('hey'). 気が変わったのか uses のか for a direct, slightly demanding question — typical masculine speech.

text: スピラのために / エヴォンのために
translation: For Spira. / For Yevon.

vocabulary.meaning: for the sake of, for the purpose of

grammar: Two parallel ために phrases with no main verb — the predicate is implied from context (she is marrying 'for Spira, for Yevon'). Ellipsis emphasizes the gravity of each reason.

text: そうするのが一番いいと思いました / 説明になっていない
translation: I thought it would be the best thing to do. / That's not an explanation.
grammar: そうするのが一番いい — nominalizer の turns the verb phrase into a subject. 説明になっていない: Auron's deadpan rebuttal, 'that doesn't constitute an explanation.'

text: もしかしてジスカル様のことが関係してるの?
translation: Could it be that it has something to do with Lord Jyscal?

vocabulary.meaning: could it be that, perhaps, by any chance
to be related to, to be connected to

grammar: 関係してるの — the の at the end makes this a soft, curious yes/no question (feminine register). もしかして adds the sense of cautious speculation.

text: あ、あのスピア
translation: Ah — that sphere…
grammar: Hesitant speech — the speaker trails off, leaving the thought incomplete. The double あ and あの mark flustered hesitation.

text: 見せろ / できません / まずシーモアローシと話さねばなりません
translation: Show it to me. / I cannot. / I must first speak with Maester Seymour.
grammar: 見せろ is the plain imperative of 見せる — blunt and commanding. 話さねばならない is a formal/literary obligation form: 話す + ねば (literary なければ) + ならない.

text: 本当に申し訳ないのですが
translation: I am truly sorry, but…

vocabulary.meaning: I'm sorry, inexcusable, I have no excuse

grammar: 申し訳ないのですが — のですが adds a softening explanatory tone and leaves the sentence hanging, implying 'but there's a reason I can't comply.' A polite way to refuse.

text: これは個人的な問題です
translation: This is a personal matter.

text: 水くせえな
translation: That's cold of you.

vocabulary.meaning: cold, distant, stand-offish (lit. 'watery/tasteless'); treating friends like strangers

grammar: 水くせえ is dialectal/rough-speech form of 水くさい. The figurative meaning 'distant, cold, not treating us as friends' is the intended one here. Wakka's complaint that Yuna isn't confiding in them.

text: 好きにしろ / すみません / だが今一度聞く
translation: Do as you like. / I'm sorry. / But I'll ask one more time.
grammar: 好きにしろ is a blunt imperative — 'suit yourself.' 今一度 is a formal/literary adverb meaning 'one more time,' giving Auron's follow-up question a weighty, deliberate tone.

text: 旅はやめません
translation: I will not stop the journey.

vocabulary.meaning: to stop, to quit, to give up

text: ならばよかろう
translation: Then that will do.

vocabulary.meaning: in that case, if so (formal/literary conditional)
that will do, very well (archaic/formal form of いいだろう)

grammar: ならばよかろう is archaic/formal — ならば (literary 'if so') + よかろう (archaic volitional/conjectural of よい, meaning 'it shall be fine'). Characteristic of Auron's speech style.

text: ちょっと待てよアーロン / 旅さえしてれば後はどうでもいいのかよ
translation: Wait a minute, Auron. / As long as she keeps traveling, you don't care about the rest?

vocabulary.meaning: as long as, if only (conditional with さえ)
doesn't matter, it's all the same

grammar: 旅さえしてれば: さえ〜ば construction — 'if only/as long as [she] travels.' Tidus is challenging Auron's seemingly indifferent stance.

text: その通りだ
translation: Exactly.

text: シンと戦う覚悟さえ捨てなければ / 何をしようと召喚師の自由だ
translation: As long as she doesn't abandon her resolve to fight Sin, a summoner is free to do whatever she wants.

vocabulary.meaning: as long as one doesn't (negative conditional)

grammar: 覚悟さえ捨てなければ — さえ〜なければ: 'as long as she doesn't even abandon her resolve.' 何をしようと: volitional + と = 'no matter what she does.'

text: それは召喚師の権利だ / 覚悟と控えのな
translation: That is a summoner's right. / Her resolve and her discretion.
grammar: 覚悟と控えのな — の here is a possessive/explanatory particle (archaic or assertive masculine usage); the full phrase means 'both resolve and discretion belong to [the summoner].' Auron's characteristic terse style drops the main clause.

text: でもなんか
translation: But somehow…
grammar: Sentence trails off — Tidus can't quite articulate his unease. でもなんか functions as an incomplete thought, conveying emotional ambivalence.

text: ユーナ / 一個だけ質問がある
translation: Yuna. / I have just one question.
grammar: 一個だけ — だけ limits to 'just one.' Using 一個 (counter for objects) for a question is very casual/colloquial, fitting Tidus's informal speech.

text: シーモア老子と話すだけじゃダメなのか
translation: Isn't it enough to just talk with Maester Seymour?

vocabulary.meaning: old master; here used as a title approximation (マスター/老師 = Maester)

grammar: 〜だけじゃダメなのか — 'isn't just ~ enough?' の makes it an explanatory question; か makes it interrogative. Tidus is questioning why she needs to actually marry.

text: 結婚しないとまずいってか? / わからない
translation: Does she have to actually marry? / I don't know.

vocabulary.meaning: if not done, it'll be a problem; have to do
is that what you're saying? you mean ~ ? (colloquial)

grammar: 結婚しないとまずい: 〜ないと + まずい = 'if she doesn't marry, it'll be problematic' → 'she has to marry.' ってか is colloquial, seeking confirmation of an interpretation.

text: でも、覚悟は必要なんだと思う
translation: But I think resolve is necessary.
grammar: 〜なんだと思う — んだ adds an explanatory/assertive nuance before と思う ('I think'); softer than a flat assertion but still confident.

text: そ、そうか
translation: I… I see.

vocabulary.meaning: I see, is that so (neutral acknowledgment)

grammar: The stutter そ、そうか indicates Tidus is caught off guard and is processing an uncomfortable realization.

text: 言うな
translation: Don't say it.
grammar: 言うな — plain negative imperative: verb stem + な = 'don't ~.' Short, sharp, emotional — Tidus doesn't want to hear whatever is about to be said.

text: うるさい!
translation: Shut up!

text: 覚悟ばっかりさせて、ごめんね。
translation: I'm sorry for always making you brace yourself.
grammar: 覚悟ばっかりさせて — causative te-form: 'making [you] do nothing but brace yourself.' The te-form here expresses the reason for the apology. ごめんね is soft/feminine.

text: いいの?
translation: Is that really okay?
grammar: いいの? — rising intonation no-question, soft and feminine. Asking 'is it really alright?' with a nuance of concern or disbelief.

text: 大丈夫。
translation: It's fine.

text: 何がごめんねで、何が大丈夫なのか。
translation: What exactly is she sorry about, and what exactly is fine?
grammar: Rhetorical internal monologue. Two parallel 何が〜 constructions expressing Tidus's confusion. のか turns it into a wondering/rhetorical question rather than an actual interrogative.

text: 何が覚悟で、何が権利なのか。
translation: What is resolve, and what is a right?
grammar: Continuation of Tidus's internal confusion. Parallel 何が structure — rhetorical self-questioning about the terms the adults keep using.

text: よくわからなかった。
translation: I just didn't really understand.
grammar: Past tense narration — Tidus looking back on his confusion in that moment. よく adds the nuance of 'properly' or 'at all.'

text: みんなと考えが離れてしまったような気がして。 / みんなと離れちゃったら、俺はこのスピラで…
translation: I felt like I had drifted away from everyone's thinking. / If I became separated from everyone, then I in this Spira would be…

vocabulary.meaning: to become separated from, to drift away from
to end up doing (often with regret)
to have a feeling that, to feel as if
to end up separated (contraction of 離れてしまう)

grammar: 〜ような気がして — て-form leaves the clause hanging, linking to the next thought. 離れちゃったら: conditional from 離れちゃう (離れてしまう), 'if I end up separated.'

text: 一人だ
translation: Alone.
grammar: Single word completing the trailing thought from clip_035. Stark and deliberate — the sentence break amplifies the emotional impact.

text: 自分が一人きりなのを感じるのは…
translation: Feeling that you're completely alone…
grammar: 〜なのを感じる: nominalized clause (一人きりな) as object of 感じる. のは sets up the subject for a predicate that trails off (…), building toward the next clip.

text: 辛かった
translation: …was painful.
grammar: Completes the のは〜 topic from clip_037: 'As for feeling completely alone… it was painful.' The split across clips gives it dramatic pause.

text: ともあれ、ひとまずはマカラーニャ寺院を目指す / ユーナはシーマーとはいい
translation: Anyway, for now we head for Macalania Temple. / As for Yuna and Seymour, that's fine —

vocabulary.meaning: anyway, in any case, be that as it may
for now, for the time being
to aim for, to head toward

grammar: ともあれ and ひとまず both signal a pragmatic shift — 'whatever the situation, for now let's focus on X.' The sentence cuts off mid-thought, continued in clip_040.

text: 好きに話し合えばいい / 俺たちガードはその結論を待ち / 以降の旅の計画を考える
translation: Let them talk as they see fit. / We guardians will wait for that conclusion / and think about the plan for the journey from there.

vocabulary.meaning: to discuss, to talk things over
it's fine if, all they need to do is

grammar: 好きに話し合えばいい — conditional + いい: 'it's fine if they talk freely.' 待ち is a conjunctive form connecting to the following verb, expressing sequential actions.

text: いいな
translation: Understood?
grammar: いいな as a closing instruction-check — 'is that clear?' Masculine, slightly commanding. Auron wrapping up his instructions to the group.

text: ユーナのことが気になるか
translation: Are you worried about Yuna?

vocabulary.meaning: to be concerned about, to weigh on one's mind, to be curious about

grammar: 〜のことが気になる: のこと turns Yuna into a topic of concern. 気になる is literally 'it becomes a worry in one's mind.' Direct question with no か particle inflection — Auron's blunt style.

text: 気にすんなってのが無理だよ / 何するつもりなんだ
translation: Telling me not to worry is impossible. / What does she intend to do?

vocabulary.meaning: don't do (colloquial negative imperative of する)

grammar: 気にすんなってのが無理: 気にするな → 気にすんな (colloquial contraction) + って (quotation) + の (nominalizer) + が無理 = 'the thing of being told not to worry is impossible.' Tidus reports the impossible instruction as its own subject.

text: 単純に考えれば
translation: If you think about it simply —
grammar: 考えれば — conditional ba-form: 'if one thinks.' The clause hangs unfinished, continued in clip_045. Sets up Auron's logical deduction.

text: 結婚を承諾することを材料にして / シーモアと交渉するつもりなんだろうな
translation: She probably intends to use her acceptance of the marriage as a bargaining chip to negotiate with Seymour.

vocabulary.meaning: to accept, to consent to, to agree to
material, ingredient; here: bargaining chip, leverage

grammar: 材料にして — にして is 'using ~ as'; the te-form connects to the following clause. Auron lays out his logical inference. だろうな softens it to 'I'd suppose.'

text: 何の交渉 / そうな
translation: Negotiation for what? / Probably so.

vocabulary.meaning: what kind of, what sort of
seems so, probably (that's the way it is)

grammar: 何の交渉 — abbreviated question ('negotiation for what?'). そうな is colloquial 'seems like it' — Auron confirming Tidus's implicit follow-up.

text: 一人で大丈夫かな
translation: I wonder if she'll be okay on her own.
grammar: 〜かな — sentence-final particle expressing wondering/self-directed doubt: 'I wonder if…' Softer and more internal than か alone.

text: 望み薄だな / シーモアの方が役者が上だ
translation: Prospects are slim. / Seymour is the better actor.

vocabulary.meaning: actor; by extension, a skilled maneuverer/player

grammar: 役者が上 — literally 'is a superior actor,' used figuratively: Seymour is a more skilled manipulator/negotiator. This is a common figurative use of 役者.

text: 分かってんならさ / 何とかしない?
translation: If you know that, / why don't you do something about it?

vocabulary.meaning: to do something about it, to manage somehow

grammar: 分かってんなら — colloquial contraction of 分かっているなら: 'if you know.' さ adds a pressing, slightly frustrated tone. 何とかしない is a negative-form invitation: 'won't you do something?'

text: ユーナがそれを望んでいない
translation: Yuna doesn't want that.

vocabulary.meaning: to wish for, to desire, to want

grammar: 〜ていない — progressive negative: 'is not wishing for it.' Auron states it as a settled fact, not a judgment.

text: それも分からないんだよな / 俺たち信用ないのか
translation: That's something I don't get either. / Does she not trust us?
grammar: 〜んだよな — explanatory + seeking agreement. 信用ないのか: の here is explanatory, か makes it a question — 'is it that we have no trust with her?' Tidus venting.

text: 逆だな / 皆を巻き込まぬよう
translation: The opposite. / So as not to involve everyone.

vocabulary.meaning: to involve, to drag into, to entangle
so as to, in order to (negative purpose)

grammar: 巻き込まぬよう — classical negative ぬ + ように (purpose): 'so as not to involve everyone.' A literary construction; Auron speaks with a formal register.

text: 一人で解決しようと決意している
translation: She is resolved to settle it on her own.

vocabulary.meaning: to resolve, to make a firm decision
intending to do, with the aim of doing

grammar: 解決しようと決意している: 〜しようと + 決意する = 'to be determined to do ~.' The ている indicates an ongoing state of resolve.

text: うん、そんな感じだ / でもそっちの方が心配するっつーの
translation: Yeah, that's the feeling. / But that's exactly what makes me more worried.

vocabulary.meaning: that kind of feeling, that vibe
that's exactly the thing! (colloquial emphatic, expressing mild frustration)

grammar: 〜っつーの: colloquial contraction of というのは — here an emphatic ending expressing 'but that's the very thing that worries me!' Captures Tidus's exasperation.

text: 話してくれるだけでいいのにさ
translation: It would be enough if she'd just talk to us.

vocabulary.meaning: even though, it would be fine if (expressing mild complaint)

grammar: のにさ — のに expresses contrast/regret ('even though it would be fine'); さ softens and adds a plaintive tone. Full nuance: 'If she'd just talk, that'd be all we need — but she doesn't.'

text: それができん娘なのだ / 気まじめで、思い込みが激しく甘え下手だ
translation: That's the kind of girl she is — she can't do that. / Too earnest, prone to assumptions, and bad at asking for help.

vocabulary.meaning: cannot do (dialectal/archaic negative of できる)
very serious, earnest to a fault
assumption, firm but possibly wrong belief
bad at being dependent on others, unable to lean on people

grammar: できん is archaic/dialectal for できない — fitting Auron's formal speech. 甘え下手: 甘える (to be dependent, to lean on someone) + 下手 (bad at) — 'bad at relying on others.'

text: よく見てんな
translation: You really pay attention.

vocabulary.meaning: to see, to observe, to watch

grammar: 見てんな — contraction of 見ているな: 'you really are watching/observing.' な here is not imperative but an admiring/impressed sentence-final particle.

text: 言うのはわかりやすい / はは、確かに
translation: Saying it is easy. / Haha, true enough.

vocabulary.meaning: easy to understand; here: easy to say/describe

grammar: 言うのはわかりやすい — のは nominalizes 言う as the topic: 'as for saying it, it's easy/simple.' Auron's self-aware admission that describing Yuna is easier than helping her.

text: いつかガードの出番が来る その時はお前が支えてやる
translation: The guardians' moment will come. When it does, you'll be the one to support her.

vocabulary.meaning: one's turn, one's moment to act
to do for someone (often implying doing a favor, masculine)

grammar: 支えてやる — te-form + やる: doing something for another person (benevolent, masculine). Auron is telling Tidus directly that his role will be to support Yuna emotionally.

text: 遅い
translation: You're late.

text: 俺は不思議と落ち着いていた 優奈の結婚は
translation: Strangely, I was calm. Yuna's marriage —

vocabulary.meaning: to calm down, to settle down, to be composed

grammar: 不思議と — adverbial use: 'strangely enough.' 落ち着いていた — past progressive state: 'I was (in a state of being) calm.' The topic 優奈の結婚は is left dangling, resolved in clip_062.

text: 俺が想像するような、あれやこれやの結婚じゃなくて。
translation: It wasn't the kind of marriage I'd imagine — this and that sort.
grammar: 〜ような — attributive use of よう: 'the kind that I would imagine.' あれやこれや is an idiomatic phrase meaning 'all sorts of things,' here euphemistically covering the full romantic implications of marriage.

text: そう、旅を続けるための、ちょっとした儀式みたいなもの。
translation: Right — more like a small ritual for continuing the journey.
grammar: ための nominalizes the preceding clause as purpose. みたいなもの softens the assertion — 'something like a ritual.' Tidus rationalizing the marriage to himself.

text: そういうふうに考えられるようになってたからだと思う。
translation: I think it's because I had come to be able to think of it that way.

vocabulary.meaning: to come to be able to, to reach the state where one can

grammar: 考えられるようになってた — potential + ようになる (gradual change) + ていた (past state): 'had come to be able to think.' からだと思う: 'I think it's because ~.'

text: まあ、なんていうか、諦めの境地ってやつだったのかもしれないけどさ。
translation: Well, how do I put it — maybe it was what you'd call the state of acceptance.

vocabulary.meaning: how do I put it, what you'd call
state of mind, mental state, realm
what you'd call ~, that thing called ~ (colloquial)

grammar: 諦めの境地ってやつ — ってやつ is colloquial, making the abstract term conversational: 'that thing called the state of acceptance.' のかもしれない adds hedging.

text: 行こっか、言うな。
translation: "Let's go," she said.

vocabulary.meaning: shall we ~ (casual volitional-question contraction of 〜ようか)

grammar: 行こっか is a casual contraction of 行こうか ('shall we go?'). 言うな here is a reported speech marker — 'she said ~ .' Note this is not the prohibitive imperative but a quotation marker (言う + な in reporting speech is unusual; more likely a transcription rendering of と言うな/と言った).

text: ちょっと待て
translation: Hold on.

vocabulary.meaning: hold on, wait a moment (plain imperative)

grammar: 待て — plain imperative of 待つ. Direct and commanding — Auron stopping the group.

text: 確か / この辺りだ / なんすか
translation: I believe… / it's around here. / What is it?

vocabulary.meaning: if I recall correctly, I believe, certain
what is it? (colloquial なんですか)

grammar: 確か used as a memory hedge — 'if I recall correctly.' なんすか is colloquial for なんですか — Rikku's casual speech.

text: 見せたいものがある / でもアーロンさん
translation: There's something I want to show you. / But, Auron —
grammar: 見せたいものがある — たい + もの + がある: 'there is a thing I want to show.' でもアーロンさん trails off — the interlocutor objects but Auron cuts them off.

text: すぐに済む
translation: It won't take long.

vocabulary.meaning: to be finished, to be settled, to be done

grammar: すぐに済む — 'it will be done quickly.' Auron cutting off objections with a brief reassurance.

text: ここって普通の水じゃないのか
translation: Isn't this just ordinary water?
grammar: ここって — ここ + は (topic) in colloquial form (って). 普通の水じゃないのか — 'isn't it ordinary water?' The のか makes it a slightly wondering question.

text: スフィアの原料となる水だ / 人の思いを封じとどめる力がある
translation: It's water that becomes the raw material for spheres. / It has the power to seal and hold in people's feelings.

vocabulary.meaning: to keep, to retain, to hold in place

grammar: 封じとどめる — compound verb: 封じる (to seal) + とどめる (to hold/keep). Used together to mean 'to seal and retain.' Auron explaining sphere water's unique property.

text: なんだ
translation: What is it?

vocabulary.meaning: what is it (mild surprise or inquiry)

text: 思いが集まる場所は魔物が生まれやすい
translation: Places where feelings gather are prone to fiends being born.
grammar: 生まれやすい — verb stem + やすい: 'prone to being born, likely to be born.' Explains the game mechanic of pyreflies gathering at emotionally charged locations.

text: お疲れ様でした
translation: Good work.

vocabulary.meaning: thank you for your hard work (set phrase after effort)

grammar: お疲れ様でした — polite past form, typically used to acknowledge someone's effort or to close a task/encounter. Context here is likely after a battle.

text: 吸収されてしまう
translation: It'll end up being absorbed.

vocabulary.meaning: to end up being done (passive + completion with nuance of regret)

grammar: 吸収されてしまう — passive + てしまう: 'will end up being absorbed.' The てしまう adds a sense of undesirable completion — the sphere's contents dissolving into the lake.

text: 随分古いなぁ / これは中身消えてくかもな
translation: This is pretty old. / The contents might be fading away.

vocabulary.meaning: to keep doing, to go on doing (colloquial ていく)

grammar: 消えてくかもな — 消えていく (to continue disappearing) contracted to 消えてく + かも (maybe) + な (softener). Conversational conjecture about the sphere degrading.

text: 10年前
translation: Ten years ago.

text: ジェクトが残したスピアだ
translation: It's a sphere Jecht left behind.

vocabulary.meaning: to leave behind, to leave as a record

text: 見てみろ / あ、ああ
translation: Take a look. / Oh — yeah.

vocabulary.meaning: to try looking, to have a look

grammar: 見てみろ — te-form of みてみる + imperative ろ: 'go ahead and look.' The みてみ adds a 'try it' nuance. あ、ああ is Tidus's slightly stunned acknowledgment.

text: お前何を取ってるんだ / よくわからねえが長い旅になるんだろ
translation: What are you recording? / I'm not really sure, but it's going to be a long journey.

vocabulary.meaning: I'm not really sure (colloquial, rough speech)

grammar: 取ってるんだ — progressive + んだ: explanatory/informational. Jecht uses rough masculine speech: わからねえ (colloquial for わからない).

text: 珍しいものもたくさん見れそうだ / となりゃ全部スフィアに記録しといて
translation: Seems like there'll be a lot of rare things to see. / If that's the case, I'll record it all on sphere —

vocabulary.meaning: can see (colloquial potential of 見る)
seems like, looks like (conjecture from appearance)
if that's the case (colloquial となれば)
do and keep it done (colloquial ておく + te-form)

grammar: となりゃ — highly colloquial contraction of となれば ('if it comes to that'). 記録しといて — しておく contracted to しとく, in te-form as part of incomplete sentence.

text: 女房とガキにも見せてやらねえとよ / この旅は遊びではないんだぞ
translation: Gotta show it to my wife and kid too. / This journey is not a game, you know.
grammar: 見せてやらねえとよ — やる (benefactive) + ない contracted to ねえ + と (obligation): 'gotta show them.' This is Auron interjecting: この旅は遊びではないんだぞ — ではない + んだぞ: emphatic denial.

text: しかしブラスカよ / シンと戦う召喚士様の出発だってのに
translation: But still, Braska — this is the departure of a summoner going to fight Sin,

vocabulary.meaning: even though it is ~ (emphatic contrast with complaint)

grammar: 召喚士様の出発だってのに — だって (even/even though) + のに (despite expectations): 'even though it's the departure of a summoner lord.' Jecht's complaint trails into clip_085.

text: これじゃなんだか / 世人気みたいじゃねえか
translation: This feels like… / it's like a world-weary send-off, isn't it.

vocabulary.meaning: somehow, for some reason, sort of
worldly resignation, world-weariness (rare compound; could be a rough pronunciation)

grammar: These lines use Jecht's rough, casual speech. じゃねえか is colloquial for じゃないか ('isn't it so?'). なんだか adds vagueness to the feeling being described.

text: これでいいさ / 見送りが多すぎると / かえって決意が鈍りかねない
translation: This is fine. / If there are too many people seeing us off, / it might actually dull our resolve.

vocabulary.meaning: to dull, to become blunt, to weaken
might well ~, there is a risk of ~ (negative possibility)

grammar: 鈍りかねない — 鈍る + かねない: 'might (regrettably) weaken.' かねない implies an undesirable risk. Braska's wisdom about maintaining focus.

text: そんなもんかね / おめえがここに帰るときには / もうちょい賑やかになるだろうさ
translation: Is that how it is? / When you come back here, / it'll probably be a little more lively.

vocabulary.meaning: that's how it is, that's the way things are (colloquial そんなもの)
a bit more (colloquial もう少し)

grammar: そんなもんかね — rhetorical acceptance: 'I suppose that's just how it is.' もうちょい is colloquial for もう少し. Jecht being upbeat about their return.

text: シンを倒した英雄として / 派手に凱旋パレードや
translation: As heroes who defeated Sin — a grand victory parade!

vocabulary.meaning: flashily, grandly, in a showy way

grammar: として marks the role/capacity: 'as heroes who defeated Sin.' や at the end is a Kansai/Jecht-style sentence-final particle expressing enthusiasm or assertion.

text: そろそろ行こう / 夜が明けてしまう
translation: Let's get going soon. / Dawn will break.

vocabulary.meaning: for dawn to break, for the night to end
will end up doing (with slight concern)

grammar: 夜が明けてしまう — てしまう conveys concern about the unwanted completion of nighttime. Braska gently urging the group to set off.

text: アーロンもう少し寄ってくれ
translation: Auron, come a bit closer.

vocabulary.meaning: a little more, a bit more

grammar: てくれ — te-form + くれ (plain imperative of くれる): a direct but not harsh request. Jecht asking Auron to move closer for the sphere recording.

text: よしそれでいい
translation: Good, that'll do.

text: そんな嫌がんなよ / 片仏
translation: Don't be so reluctant. / Lighten up.

vocabulary.meaning: to dislike, to be reluctant, to resist
stiff, half-Buddha (Jecht's teasing nickname/expression for Auron's seriousness)

grammar: 嫌がんなよ — colloquial contraction of 嫌がるな + よ: 'don't be so resistant.' 片仏 is likely Jecht's playful nickname for the serious Auron.

text: うるさい
translation: Shut up.

text: ブラスカ / お前も映っとけよ / ユーナちゃんへのいい土産になるぞ
translation: Braska! You get in the frame too. / It'll make a great souvenir for little Yuna.

vocabulary.meaning: to be reflected, to appear (in a recording/image)
go ahead and do (and keep it that way) (colloquial ておけ)

grammar: 映っとけよ — 映っておけ contracted to 映っとけ + よ: 'get yourself on camera (and stay there).' Jecht's casual use of raw imperatives, even with Braska.

text: そうだな / ブラスカ様 / こんなことをしていては
translation: True. / Lord Braska, / if we keep doing this sort of thing —

vocabulary.meaning: this sort of thing, things like this
if one keeps doing ~ (conditional with negative implication)

grammar: こんなことをしていては — ていては sets up a negative consequence ('if we keep doing this, then…'). Auron's protest is cut off, continued in clip_096.

text: 時間がいくらあっても足りません / なーに焦ってんだが
translation: No amount of time will be enough. / What are you in such a hurry about?

vocabulary.meaning: to be impatient, to rush, to be flustered

grammar: いくらあっても足りません — いくら〜ても: 'no matter how much ~ there is, it won't be enough.' なーに焦ってんだが — なーに is Jecht's drawn-out dismissal; 焦ってんだ (colloquial for 焦っているんだ) + が (mild contradiction).

text: この旅がどういうものだか教えてやろう / アーロン
translation: Let me show you what this journey is all about. / Auron.

vocabulary.meaning: what kind of thing, what it's like
to teach, to show, to tell
I'll do (for you) — volitional of てやる, implying generosity or challenge

grammar: どういうものだか — embedded indirect question: 'what kind of thing it is.' 教えてやろう — てやる in volitional form: 'I'll show/teach you' (Braska speaking generously to Jecht).

text: なんだよ / どうにしてんだよ / 続きあるみたいだよ
translation: What? / What's going on? / Looks like there's more to it.

vocabulary.meaning: what's going on, what are you doing (colloquial)

grammar: Back to the present — party reacting to the sphere. 続きあるみたいだよ — 続きがある (there is a continuation) + みたいだよ: 'it seems there's more.'

text: おめえがこれを見てるってことは / 俺と同じようにスピラに来しまったわけだな / 帰る方法がわからなくて
translation: The fact that you're watching this means / you ended up in Spira just like me — / not knowing how to get back.

vocabulary.meaning: the fact that ~ means, if ~ then
in the same way, just like
which means, so it follows that, naturally

grammar: 〜ってことは + わけだ: logical deduction chain — 'the fact that X means it follows that Y.' 来しまったわけだな: 来てしまった contracted + わけだ (logical conclusion) + な (self-confirmation). Jecht's message directly addressed to Tidus.

text: ピーピー泣いてるんじゃないか / まあ泣きたい気持ちもわかる
translation: You're probably bawling your eyes out. / Well, I understand wanting to cry.
grammar: ピーピー泣いてるんじゃないか — んじゃないか is a soft conjecture: 'I bet you're crying.' まあ signals a pivot to empathy. 泣きたい気持ちもわかる: 'I understand the feeling of wanting to cry too.'

text: 俺も人のこと言えねえよ / だがよ
translation: I'm not one to talk either. / But —

vocabulary.meaning: to talk about others, to point fingers at others

grammar: 人のこと言えねえ — 'I can't say things about others (because I'm the same).' Set phrase acknowledging one's own similar failing. だがよ — だが (but) + よ (emphatic), Jecht pivoting to his main point.

text: いつまでもウジウジ泣いてんじゃねえぞ / なんだって
translation: Don't keep moping and crying forever. / What did you say?
grammar: 泣いてんじゃねえぞ — progressive + negative imperative in rough speech: 'don't be crying.' ぞ adds force. なんだって is Tidus's (or a bystander's) surprised reaction to Jecht's blunt message.

text: おめえは俺の息子なんだからな
translation: Because you're my son.

vocabulary.meaning: because ~ (providing a definitive reason), it's a fact that ~

grammar: なんだからな — んだから gives a definitive explanatory reason; な softens and personalizes it. The full sentence: 'Because you are my son [you should be tough].' Key emotional moment.

text: なんだ
translation: What…
grammar: Tidus's stunned reaction — short, trailing off. The ellipsis of a response when words fail.

text: だめだ / またまらしねえよ
translation: No good — I can't hold it back again.
grammar: またまらしねえよ — likely またとまらせない or またまらせない (colloquial), meaning 'can't stop it again' — referring to tears. Jecht's voice breaking as he records the message for his son.

text: とにかく元気で来るぜや
translation: Anyway, take care of yourself.

vocabulary.meaning: in good health, take care (farewell expression)
dialectal emphatic ending (Jecht's Zanarkand speech pattern)

grammar: 元気でいろ/来い → 元気で来るぜや: Jecht's rough send-off blending ぜ (masculine assertion) and や (dialectal). A typical Jecht farewell — gruff but warm.

text: そんだけだ
translation: That's all.

vocabulary.meaning: that's all, just that (colloquial それだけ)

grammar: そんだけだ — colloquial contraction of それだけだ. Jecht's terse wrap-up, pretending not to be emotional.

text: じゃあな
translation: See ya.

text: 最後だけマジなフリしたって
translation: Pretending to be serious only at the end —

vocabulary.meaning: to pretend, to act as if

grammar: 〜したって — colloquial concessive: 'even if you do ~.' Tidus reacting with typical tsundere deflection — criticizing Jecht's sincerity even as he's clearly moved.

text: 説得力ねえってな
translation: It's just not convincing.

vocabulary.meaning: I'm saying that ~ (self-directed quotation, trailing assertion)

grammar: 説得力ねえ — colloquial 説得力がない. ってな is Tidus internally asserting his own dismissal. The whole line is deflection — he's covering emotional vulnerability with criticism.

text: フリではない / あの時 ジェクトはすでに覚悟を決めていた
translation: He was not pretending. / At that time, Jecht had already made up his mind.

vocabulary.meaning: to make up one's mind, to resolve oneself (to something difficult)

grammar: Auron correcting Tidus directly. 覚悟を決めていた — ていた shows the resolved state at that past time: 'had already decided.' すでに emphasizes that the decision was firm.

text: 覚悟? / ジェクトはいつでもザナルカンドの家に帰ることを口にしていた
translation: Resolve? / Jecht was always talking about going home to Zanarkand.

vocabulary.meaning: to mention, to speak of, to put into words

grammar: 口にしていた — 'was (habitually) putting it into words,' i.e., constantly talking about it. Tidus challenging Auron's claim with evidence of Jecht's stated intentions.

text: 風景をスフィアに収め続けたのは / 帰ってからお前に見せるためだ
translation: The reason he kept recording the scenery on sphere / was to show it to you after he got back.

vocabulary.meaning: to store, to contain; here: to record/capture
to keep doing, to continue doing
the reason ~ is for the purpose of ~

grammar: 収め続けたのは〜ためだ — のは〜ためだ: cleft sentence explaining purpose/reason. 帰ってから: 'after returning.' Auron explaining Jecht's true motivation.

text: しかし旅を続け スピラを知り ブラスカの覚悟を知り
translation: But as he continued the journey, came to know Spira, came to know Braska's resolve —

vocabulary.meaning: to come to know, to learn

grammar: Series of conjunctive forms (続け、知り、知り) — classical-style enumeration of events leading to a conclusion. Each 〜し/〜け lists an action without explicit conjunction, creating a building rhythm.

text: そう 前に進み続けるうちに ジェクトの気持ちは変わった
translation: Yes — as he kept moving forward, Jecht's feelings changed.

vocabulary.meaning: while, in the course of, as

grammar: 〜続けるうちに — 'while continuing to ~.' うちに expresses gradual change occurring over the course of an activity. Auron narrating Jecht's inner transformation.

text: ジェクトはブラスカと共にシンと戦うことに決めた
translation: Jecht decided to fight Sin together with Braska.
grammar: 〜ことに決めた — nominalizer こと + に決める: 'decided on the matter of doing ~.' Auron delivering the key revelation about Jecht's final choice.

text: 帰るの?諦めたってことか? / 覚悟とはそういうものだ
translation: Going back? Does that mean he gave up? / That is what resolve is.

vocabulary.meaning: to give up, to resign oneself
does that mean ~? so it means ~?
as for resolve, what resolve is

grammar: 〜ってことか — colloquial comprehension check: 'so you're saying that ~?' 覚悟とはそういうものだ — とは marks 覚悟 as the topic being defined: 'that is what resolve is.' Auron's philosophical statement.

text: なんとなく分かった / 親父はザナルカンドに帰る方法が見つからないから
translation: I sort of understand. / Because my dad couldn't find a way back to Zanarkand —

vocabulary.meaning: somehow, vaguely, without a clear reason
to be found, to come to light

grammar: なんとなく分かった — 'I sort of got it.' なんとなく softens the understanding to 'vaguely/emotionally.' Tidus beginning to process and reframe Jecht's story.

text: 覚悟した / 本当は帰りたかったけど
translation: He resolved himself. / Even though he really wanted to go back.

vocabulary.meaning: to prepare oneself, to resolve oneself
want to go back, want to return

grammar: 本当は〜けど — 'even though in truth he wanted to ~.' けど softens the contrast. Tidus articulating his compassionate reinterpretation of his father.

text: 帰れないから覚悟を決めた / そうしないと前に進めなかったんだと思う
translation: Because he couldn't go back, he resolved himself. / I think if he hadn't, he wouldn't have been able to move forward.

vocabulary.meaning: to resolve oneself, to make up one's mind

grammar: そうしないと前に進めなかった: double negative — 'if he didn't do that, he couldn't move forward' = 'he had to do it to move forward.' んだと思う adds explanatory conjecture.

text: それにもし帰る方法を見つけたとしても / 途中で仲間と別れるなんて
translation: And even if he had found a way back, / parting with his companions in the middle of the journey —

vocabulary.meaning: partway through, in the middle of
the idea of ~, such a thing as ~ (often expressing disbelief or dismissal)

grammar: もし〜たとしても — 'even if ~ had happened (hypothetically).' 途中で別れるなんて — なんて expresses something unthinkable or dismissed; sentence trails into clip_122.

text: できなかったと思う / さて出発するっすよ
translation: I think he couldn't have done it. / Right then, let's head out.

vocabulary.meaning: to be able to, to manage
let's ~ / I tell you (casual ですよ, Rikku's speech)

grammar: できなかったと思う completes Tidus's thought from clip_121. さて — a pragmatic pivot marker. 出発するっすよ — Rikku's casual ます-equivalent speech with っす.

text: 諦めが
translation: Resignation —
grammar: Subject left hanging — completed by clip_124. The pause between 諦めが and its predicate creates contemplative weight.

text: 覚悟に変わったような気がした
translation: — had turned into resolve, I felt.

vocabulary.meaning: to have a feeling that, to feel as though

grammar: 諦めが覚悟に変わった — change-of-state: AがBに変わる = 'A changed into B.' ような気がした softens to personal intuition: 'I felt as if.' Tidus applying Jecht's story to himself.

text: なんすか / ジェクトはお前を愛していた
translation: What is it? / Jecht loved you.
grammar: 愛していた — progressive past: 'was loving' = 'loved.' Auron stating this as a simple, definitive fact. The directness amplifies the emotional weight for Tidus.

text: 気持ち悪いこと言うなよ / しかし愛し方はわからなかったと言っていた
translation: Don't say creepy things. / But he said he didn't know how to show it.

vocabulary.meaning: way of loving, how to love

grammar: 愛し方 — verb stem 愛し + 方 (way of doing): 'the way to love.' Auron quoting Jecht directly: 'he said he didn't know how to love.' Tidus's defensive refusal and Auron's patient follow-up.

text: 親父の話はもういいって / これだけは伝えたかった
translation: I've heard enough about my dad. / But this was the one thing I wanted to convey.

vocabulary.meaning: to convey, to tell, to pass on
wanted to do (past tense of たい)

grammar: もういいって — って as a quotative/emphatic marker dismissing the topic. これだけは伝えたかった — だけは singles out 'this one thing': 'this was the one thing I really wanted to tell you.'

text: そりゃどう思う
translation: What do you make of that?

vocabulary.meaning: what do you think, how do you feel about it

grammar: Auron's rare direct question to Tidus — asking him to reflect on what he just heard. どう思う is very direct and almost challengingly intimate coming from Auron.

text: ありがとう
translation: Thank you.
grammar: A single-word response that carries enormous weight — Tidus thanking Auron for telling him about Jecht's true feelings. The brevity is emotionally resonant.

text: ユーナ様お迎えに参上いたしました
translation: Lady Yuna, I have come to escort you.

vocabulary.meaning: to come, to arrive (humble polite verb)

grammar: 参上いたしました — double-humble: 参上 (humble 'to come/present oneself') + いたす (humble form of する) + ました (polite past). Extreme formal/humble address by Seymour's retainer.

text: こんなに早くにお返事をいただけるとは
translation: To receive a reply so quickly — (I am surprised).
grammar: 〜とは — used after a surprising discovery/realization: 'to think that ~ (what a surprise).' The predicate (e.g., 思いませんでした/驚きました) is omitted — typical of formal surprise expressions.

text: 全くもって予想外の出来事
translation: An utterly unexpected turn of events.
grammar: Nominal sentence — no main verb, functioning as an exclamation or continuation of the previous thought. 全くもって is a formal emphatic adverb.

text: 何も告げずに留守にしたこと / シーモア様になりかわり
translation: For being away without telling anyone — / on behalf of Lord Seymour,

vocabulary.meaning: to tell, to inform, to announce
to be away, to leave unattended
to act on behalf of, to substitute for

grammar: 告げずに — classical negative of 告げる + ずに: 'without informing.' なりかわり — conjunctive form: 'on behalf of/substituting for.' Formal apology delivered in Seymour's name.

text: それはいいんです
translation: That's fine.
grammar: いいんです — いい + んです: 'it's fine (really).' Yuna gently dismissing the apology to get to her actual question.

text: あの一つ聞きたいことが / なんなりと
translation: Um, there's one thing I want to ask — / Please, anything.

vocabulary.meaning: want to ask, want to hear
anything at all, whatever you wish (formal/deferential)

grammar: 一つ聞きたいことが — が left without predicate, trailing off into polite hesitation. なんなりと is a formal, deferential expression inviting any question.

text: 私結婚しても旅を続けたいんです
translation: Even if I get married, I want to continue my journey.
grammar: 〜てもです — even-if concessive; Yuna's actual condition for agreeing to the marriage. んです adds explanatory/emphatic nuance — this is the heart of her request to Seymour's envoy.

text: シーモアロー氏は許してくださるでしょうか / それはもう、シーゴア様もそのつもりでいらっしゃいます。
translation: Will Lord Seymour permit it? / But of course — Lord Seymour intends for exactly that.

vocabulary.meaning: to permit, to allow, to forgive
I wonder if, will ~ (polite conjecture question)
to be, to exist (honorific form of いる/ある)

grammar: でしょうか — polite yes/no question with conjecture nuance. それはもう — emphatic affirmative, 'of course!' いらっしゃいます — honorific for います, applied to Seymour with maximum deference.

text: 行ってきます。
translation: I'm off.

vocabulary.meaning: I'm going (and will come back) — standard Japanese farewell when leaving

grammar: 行ってきます — set phrase combining 行く + てくる (go and come back), used when leaving a place. Culturally loaded: implies intention to return, making it poignant in Yuna's context.

text: さて、グワードのしきたりがありましてな。
translation: Well now, there is a Guado custom, you see.
grammar: ありましてな — ある in polite conjunctive form (ありまして) + な (softening/explanatory): 'there is, you see.' A formal but friendly explanation of a cultural restriction.

text: 皆様はもう少しだけここでお待ちください。
translation: Everyone, please wait here just a little longer.
grammar: お〜ください — honorific request form: o + verb stem + ください = polite 'please do.' もう少しだけ: だけ limits to 'just a little.' Formal address to the party.

text: ほどなく迎えをよこしますゆえ。
translation: We will send someone to fetch you before long.
grammar: ゆえ — classical/formal sentence-final or causal particle: 'therefore/because.' Used here as a polite, slightly archaic closing: 'as we will send an escort presently.' よこす means specifically to send something toward the listener.

text: あの… / ガードはいつでも召喚師の味方だ。好きなようにやってみろ
translation: Um… / Guardians are always on the summoner's side. Do it however you like.

vocabulary.meaning: in whatever way one likes, freely
to try doing, to give it a go

grammar: やってみろ — imperative of やってみる: 'try doing it.' Auron's rare encouragement — telling Yuna she has the guardians' full support regardless of what she decides to do.

text: 悪かったな… / お前のセリフだった…
translation: Sorry about that… / That was supposed to be your line…

vocabulary.meaning: I'm sorry, my bad (past form expressing apology)
line (in a script/play), what someone was going to say

grammar: 悪かったな — past form as apology: 'that was bad of me / sorry.' セリフだった — 'that was [supposed to be] your line.' Auron acknowledging he stole Tidus's moment to say those words to Yuna.

text: ユーラ!
translation: Yuna!
grammar: An exclamation — Tidus calling out to Yuna as she leaves. The slightly off pronunciation (ユーラ instead of ユーナ) may reflect Tidus's emotional state or his accent.
